The Gap

Lack of access to capital in underserved regions

  • 80%+ of venture capital concentrated in developed regions (U.S., EU, China)
  • Only 2% of VC funding goes to Sub-Saharan Africa and other underserved regions
  • 60% of founders in underserved regions rely on personal loans or family funding

Many fail to scale due to a lack of global network access, which limits them from accessing capital to grow or start their business.

Platform Workflow Overview

1
Profile Creation & AI Initial Evaluation
2
AI Matchmaking – Level 1 (Smart Match & Chat)
3
AI Matchmaking – Level 2 (In-depth Meetings & Projections)

Step 1 – Build Your Profile

  • Founder info: Name, company, HQ, sector, stage
  • Company metrics: Years operating, equity offered, capital required
  • Product: Description, problem solved, target market, pitch deck
  • AI evaluates: Clarity & completeness automatically
  • Professional summary compiled and purely visible to investors

Step 2 – Smart Investor Matchmaking

Matches are driven by sector, stage, and investment alignment, bypassing geographical bias.

  • Combines founder profile data with direct investor preferences.
  • Not based on geography—strictly focused on finding the best strategic fit.
  • In-app chat enables direct, secure communication to explore interest.
  • Founders can seamlessly engage and gauge investor readiness.

Step 3 – In-Depth Meetings & Planning (Premium Level 2)

  • Schedule in-depth meetings with investors following primary matchmaking.
  • Owner inputs hypothetical capital allocation (e.g., 60% marketing, 40% R&D).
  • AI processes metrics to provide cash flow projections, growth potential, and risk insights.
  • Critically: AI provides no recommendations, preserving owner autonomy and preventing bias.
  • Owners experiment with allocations, then send finalized decisions directly to the investor to accelerate deal flow.
